doc.title: Chazz Frichtel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 13, 2016

title: 'Here We Go', a song about war
summary: He wrote 'Here We Go' after 9/11 as a reaction to constant war.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Okay. The last blindfold is a lyric. Who wrote, “they say the cause is true, but then again they always do.”

“Here We Go.” And it was my — it seems like my entire lifetime we have been at war with somebody. And after 9/11 I don’t know, one day it just occurred to me, oh here we go again. Obviously we didn’t ask for that. But I just thought wow, here we go and we don’t really know what we’re getting into in this deal. And here we are 15, 16 years later,
still at war. So I guess that was kind of my Twenty-First Century “War: What’s it good for? Absolutely nothing.”
Yeah. Well it’s a lovely tune with a strong sentiment.
